List a step's examples or read a complete example

Usage:
  wuko reference example TYPE [ID] [flags]

Arguments:
  TYPE
      Built-in step type from wuko reference step
  [ID]
      Stable topic or example ID from the corresponding reference index

Examples:
  wuko reference example file
  wuko reference example set basic --format yaml
  wuko reference example shell basic --format json

Flags:
      --format string  example output format: text, json, or yaml (single-file examples only) (default "text")
  -h, --help           help for example

Global Flags:
      --config string           read CLI configuration from a YAML file instead of the current directory
      --debug                   trace workflow loading, validation, and execution to stderr (may expose non-secret configuration)
      --env-loader stringArray  load the invocation environment with auto, none, mise, asdf, or direnv (repeatable)
      --frozen-lockfile         require existing local plugin pins without modifying wuko.lock
      --no-config               ignore CLI configuration, including the default workflow

Behavior:
  Offline and non-interactive. Ignores local configuration. Text is the default; JSON is one schema_version: 1 document on stdout. Errors use stderr and a nonzero exit status. Does not run workflows, plugins, or examples.

Related help:
  wuko help
  wuko reference
  wuko reference topic agents
